svg.title: Figure 03 · Risk-neutral GBM paths and terminal price distribution
svg.desc: S₀ = K = 100, r = 5%, q = 0, σ = 20%, T = 1; random seed 1973. The shaded right tail is the event S_T > K. These are model simulations, not market observations.
